faqs.question: How do I know this fits my MacBook?
faqs.answer: This is matched to the MacBook Pro 13-inch, model A2338. Check the model number on the bottom of your MacBook, or send us a photo on WhatsApp and we'll confirm before you order.

faqs.question: Does this include the lid, or just the screen panel?
faqs.answer: This is the full assembly — the LCD panel and lid/rear housing come as one complete unit, ready to swap in.

faqs.question: Does the color need to match?
faqs.answer: This listing is Space Gray. If your MacBook is a different color, message us on WhatsApp and we'll let you know what's available.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with this assembly?
